question: Will a 15 W chip stay under 85 C on this heat sink without a fan?
headline: Hottest point reaches 70.3 C (limit 85 C) at (30, 29.9, 0) mm at steady state.
confidence_reasons: passed mesh convergence, energy balance, hand calculation, units and sanity

checks.name: mesh convergence
checks.summary: temperature rise at the hottest point settled: 30.3 -> 30.2 -> 30.3 C over 3 meshes, last change 0.2%

checks.name: energy balance
checks.summary: heat in 15 W, heat out through the surfaces 15 W (3.1e-07% apart)

checks.name: hand calculation
checks.summary: heat balance on a uniform skin gives 68.1 C; the FEA skin averages 68.1 C (0.0029% of the rise). Biot 3.1e-05: the part is nearly isothermal

assumptions: Aluminum 6063-T5: conductivity 209 W/(m K), specific heat 900 J/(kg K), density 2700 kg/m3.
Heat enters through bottom and box 17.5,17.5,-1,42.5,42.5,0.5.
Convection uses a fixed film coefficient; real coefficients vary with temperature and airflow.
Surrounding air or coolant at 40 C does not heat up.
Contact resistance between parts and internal airflow are not modeled.

_figures: Temperature with the hottest point marked

notes: Built from heatsink.py with base=6, size=60, fins=9, fin=1.5, fin_height=30.
